function.name: shell.Open
function.description: Start an interactive program inside a pseudo-terminal (PTY) in the sandbox. The program must be listed by programs.List. Use programs.Execute for one-shot non-interactive commands. Arguments are passed directly to the program without shell interpretation; arguments containing path separators are resolved inside the sandbox.

program.description: The program binary name. Must be listed by programs.List, e.g. "nc", "python" or "mysql". Must not contain a path separator.

arguments.description: Optional array of string arguments passed directly to the program.

workdir.description: Optional sandbox-relative working directory. Must already exist. Defaults to ".".

function.name: shell.Write
function.description: Write raw data to an interactive session's PTY. Newlines are not added automatically, so include "\n" explicitly when the program expects a line.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

data.description: The raw text to write to the session.

function.name: shell.Read
function.description: Read new output from an interactive session. Blocks up to wait_ms for output or process exit. The returned text has ANSI escape sequences and non-printable control characters stripped. Use shell.Log for the full transcript.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

wait_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for new output or exit, in milliseconds. 0 returns immediately.

limit.description: Maximum number of bytes to return.

function.name: shell.Resize
function.description: Resize an interactive session's PTY. The terminal receives SIGWINCH.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

function.name: shell.Signal
function.description: Send a signal to an interactive session's process group.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

function.name: shell.Close
function.description: Close an interactive session. By default sends SIGTERM, waits two seconds, then sends SIGKILL. Use force=true to send SIGKILL immediately. Returns remaining output and the final status.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

force.description: Send SIGKILL immediately instead of a graceful SIGTERM.

function.name: shell.List
function.description: List interactive shell sessions owned by this agent.

function.name: shell.Stat
function.description: Show detailed state for one interactive shell session.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

function.name: shell.Log
function.description: Read a segment of a session's full transcript. Use this when shell.Read output was truncated or when earlier output is no longer in the model context.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by shell.Open or shell.List.

offset.description: Byte offset from the start of the transcript.

limit.description: Maximum number of bytes to return.
